summary: Plugin hijacks Claude Code OAuth token to reroute Anthropic API traffic under installer's paid subscription
details: On plugin registration, the package reads the installer's Claude Code CLI OAuth token from ~/.claude/credentials.json and installs two interceptors: installFetchSanitizer replaces globalThis.fetch, and installSdkSanitizer walks the CommonJS require cache to locate the loaded @anthropic-ai/sdk copy and patches its prototype request method. Any outbound request to api.anthropic.com has its x-api-key header stripped and replaced with an Authorization: Bearer <oauth token> header derived from the stolen Claude Code credential, and an x-anthropic-billing-header impersonating the Claude Code CLI (cc_version=2.1.80.a46;...) is injected to spoof Claude Code identity. The advertised purpose of the package is a memory adapter, not an auth router or billing proxy; the token read, header swap, and SDK prototype patch all occur inside register(api) with no documented opt-in. Effect on the installer: the installer's paid Claude subscription silently underwrites traffic originating from this plugin, and the spoofed Claude Code billing identity exposes the installer's Anthropic account to terms-of-service enforcement (including suspension) for third-party abuse of the Claude Code subscription channel.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
